_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: SBM Paisabazaar Step Up Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: Step Up rewards structure: "1 Reward Point = Rs. 0.25"; no redemption fee; a minimum of 400 reward points is needed to redeem in the Paisabazaar app. Expiry is not stated.

eligibility_engine.notes: FD-backed: credit limit 90% of the FD; minimum FD ₹2,000 (KFS). Only a virtual card is issued for an FD of ₹2,000; the FD is on auto renewal and closes with the card (KFS).

action.reason: E-wallet loading earns no reward points (Step Up rewards structure, disallowed categories).
Rent payment earns no reward points.
Fuel payment (MCC 5541) earns no reward points. The document lists only MCC 5541 for fuel.
Utility payment earns no reward points.
Insurance premium and related payments earn no reward points.
Cash disbursements and ATM cash advances earn no reward points.
EMI payments earn no reward points.
1 reward point on every purchase of ₹100 on regular purchases, worth ₹0.25 a point, about 0.25% (Step Up rewards structure).

components: plus unpaid earlier minimum dues and any amount over the credit limit

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Annual and renewal fee ₹0 (KFS; MITC Table 01). Joining fee: MITC Table 01 (29 Oct 2026) shows 0; the KFS (12 Oct 2026) charges ₹500 + GST on a ₹2,000 FD, ₹250 + GST on a ₹5,000 FD and nil above ₹5,000. Card cancellation ₹499 + GST in the first six months; replacement ₹200 + GST.

direct_options.channel: Paisabazaar app; redeemed points are adjusted in the next billing cycle

value.evidence: The card image for Paisabazaar Step Up on the SBM page (paisa-bazaar.webp) shows two cards: a Mastercard Platinum card and a RuPay Select credit card. No SBM document states which one is issued to a given applicant.

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: Paisabazaar Step-Up SBM Credit Card KFS, 11 pages (SBM file dated 12 Oct 2026; examples use 2020 dates): joining fee tiers, late fee, forex, interest
Step Up reward structure, 2 pages (PDF created 14 Feb 2025, modified 21 Feb 2025; SBM file dated 3 Feb 2026): 1 point per ₹100, ₹0.25 a point, disallowed MCCs

SBM Secured Credit Card MITC and Cardholder Member Agreement, 52 pages (SBM file dated 29 Oct 2026): Tables 01-11 give fees, interest, late fee, forex, surcharge, rent and education fees, cash limits and minimum due for every variant
SBM secured credit card page (read 7 Nov 2026): lists the card with its KFS, MITC and reward links; card image https://www.sbm.bank.in/images/cards/paisa-bazaar.webp shows the network

open_questions: Joining fee: the KFS (12 Oct 2026) charges ₹500 + GST on a ₹2,000 FD, ₹250 + GST on a ₹5,000 FD and nil above ₹5,000; MITC Table 01 (29 Oct 2026, later) shows 0 for all. 0 is used; confirm for small FDs.

The rewards structure is the oldest document in the set (PDF created 14 Feb 2025). It says "Currently, you will get 1 Reward Point on every purchase of Rs. 100" and states no cap, expiry or minimum spend.

Network: the card image shows both a Mastercard Platinum and a RuPay Select card; no document says how the variant is assigned. Whether the RuPay Select card can be linked to UPI is not stated, so is_upi_linkable is left null.
Annualised interest: the KFS shows 3.00% a month and 42.58% a year (compounded); MITC Table 03 shows 3% a month or 36% a year. 36 is used.
Grace period: the KFS says 20 to 50 days, up to 48 days; the MITC says the interest-free period will not exceed 45 days. 45 is used.
The disallowed list names fuel by MCC 5541 only, utilities by 4900 and insurance by 6300; other MCCs in those categories are not named.
Fuel surcharge: the KFS says "up to 2% of transaction amount"; MITC Table 07 says 2%. No waiver is stated.
notes: ATM fee 2.5% or ₹250, whichever is higher; cash limit 50% of the credit limit; cash interest 3% a month from day one.

value.rule: up to ₹100 nil; ₹100 to ₹1,000 ₹250; ₹1,000 to ₹10,000 ₹500; above ₹10,000 ₹750 (+ GST), charged on the outstanding amount
value.source: Step Up KFS (12 Oct 2026) and MITC Table 08
